استأويت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْوَيْتُ (istaʔwaytu) /is.taʔ.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
# اِسْتَأْوَيْتَ (istaʔwayta) /is.taʔ.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
# اِسْتَأْوَيْتِ (istaʔwayti) /is.taʔ.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
